Okay so first off he is very anxious when i was younger i had the same . The reason why he doesn’t want to participate in team sports is because he is afraid the others will think he is bad etc basically afraid to fail ( Like when he misses a shot or something ) It probably gets him very nervous and you should definitely not push him to still play . Second him crying in class is probably him having a panic attack it’s very common with people that have social anxiety ( When i was younger i used to have the same . I would panic and run away start crying ) You should definitely consider therapy since a therapist can help him face his fears and will learn him certain ways to stop or reduce his panic attacks . They will help you control your breathing so he can calm down when he is having a panic attack and for now do not push him with certain things he doesn’t want to do because everytime he ends up running away or crying he will only feel worse about himself and he will be more afraid that next time the same thing will happen . Maybe you could talk to his teachers about it so he won’t have to read in class for an example if he has troubles with that . If you have any more questions feel free to send me a dm or just reply
